prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon race preparation with carbohydrate loading for peak endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and snacks for one full day
Total daily calories and carbohydrates are appropriate for high-endurance marathon training
Includes practical, specific food items with portions that support carbohydrate loading strategy
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring maximum caloric intake and carbohydrate loading for peak performance

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize protein distribution across two daily training sessions (morning strength, evening power) for muscle recovery and performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 24 hours with 4-5 distinct meals/snacks
Total daily protein is adequate for strength athlete (minimum 1.6-2.0g per kg bodyweight)
Protein is distributed across meals with emphasis around training windows (pre/post workout)
Plan is concise and actionable without excessive detail or recipes
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein distribution and recovery nutrition across multiple training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for early morning swim training and afternoon competition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three time periods: pre-dawn training, mid-day, and pre-competition afternoon
All meals and snacks are vegetarian-compliant with no animal flesh products
Includes adequate carbohydrates and protein to support swimmer's energy needs and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (swimmer) with early morning training, afternoon competition, and dietary restrictions (vegetarian/vegan)
